method: Reviewed each displayed sentence and all four choices item by item, independently determining the required conditional-clause verb form before comparing with the stored key/explanation. Checked unique-answer validity, sentence naturalness, target-skill fit, distractor plausibility, time-reference consistency, and explanation consistency. The persisted candidate format co-locates keys with stems, so strict technical answer-blinding cannot be guaranteed in this connector-only path; no item was approved without individual review.
notes: All 25 items express unreal past conditions with would/could/might have + past participle in the result clause. Past perfect is uniquely required in each if-clause among the four options, and the business contexts and stored explanations are natural and consistent. Full cross-bank semantic near-duplicate clearance remains outstanding.
